steps.en: After rights approval, configure the host and supply a price CSV
steps.zh: 核权获批后，配置宿主并提供报价 CSV

steps.en: Clean and analyze the CSV into a Markdown report
steps.zh: 清洗分析 CSV，输出 Markdown 报告

steps.en: Ask for research into the causes behind the observed price changes
steps.zh: 追问数据所示价格变化的原因

steps.en: Search and synthesize supporting evidence into an illustrated report
steps.zh: 检索并综合证据，生成配图报告

steps.en: Request standard slides that reuse the report figures and conclusions
steps.zh: 要求标准模式幻灯片复用报告图片与结论

steps.en: Route to slide production and export a PPTX when prerequisites succeed
steps.zh: 调度幻灯片制作，前提满足时导出 PPTX

value.en: Data, researched causes and slides share saved artifacts instead of three disconnected drafts
value.zh: 数据、原因研究与幻灯片共用落盘材料，不再各写各的
